summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, US equivalent of a current report) aggregating seven Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 8-11, 2026, covering share repurchases for cancellation under Main Board Rule 13.25A. The September 8 return shows 1,339,800 ordinary shares (0.1104% of existing issued shares) repurchased at HKD 18.5504 per share, with the opening and closing issued-share balance unchanged at 1,214,041,449 pending cancellation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory condition is stated. Watch the cadence and cumulative size of buybacks versus the 10% mandate, cancellation timing, and resultant EPS accretion.
